Senior Data Analyst
Location: Hyderabad | Work Model: Hybrid (3 Days in Office)

Job Description
• The Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for understanding business/department needs and goals and creating data-driven analysis and insight to support management decisions.
Your role responsibilities? Here's what you'll do.
• Construct complex queries in database management system software to pull data from multiple databases and tables, transforming raw data into meaningful, actionable results.
• Create and analyze complex financial and executive management reports, providing data-driven insights to support key business decisions.
• Query data warehouses and develop complex ad hoc reports for end users using spreadsheets, macros, and reporting tools; build and maintain data sets for reporting portals including page design, security, and report libraries.
• Collaborate with key stakeholders to determine requirements and lead projects that generate required intelligence with minimal oversight, operating as a trusted advisor on issues, trends, and best practices.
• Train new analysts on internal processes, data warehouse use, reporting, and data infrastructure; provide ongoing guidance on interpreting and applying data effectively.
• Perform and analyze data integrity audits; evaluate and propose recommendations on methods and procedures for managing data, identifying and resolving integrity issues within data warehouses.

Technology Tools
• SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI
Role Essentials
What you'll need to be successful in this role:
• Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience as a Data Analyst.
• Strong SQL experience with proficiency in querying data warehouses and constructing complex, multi-table queries.
• Strong Microsoft Excel skills including macros, with proficiency in Microsoft Windows and Office suite.
• Strong knowledge of data warehousing technologies and Power BI for reporting and data visualization.
• Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to summarize large quantities of information into clear, actionable insights.

What We'd Like to See
Preferred skills that will set you apart:
• Strong knowledge of reporting tools and systems administration within a business intelligence environment.
• Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
• Strong attention to detail, facilitation, and project management skills applied across cross-functional teams.
• Ability to influence, motivate, and mobilize team members and business partners toward shared goals and outcomes.
• Strong business and technology acumen with a demonstrated ability to establish rapport, gain stakeholder trust, and drive consensus.

About Hyland
Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation.
Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve.
